rows.evidence: The sed edit made key return (nums, 0, pre) for pre-releases and (nums, 1, "") for releases. test_prerelease_first passed in the pytest run (5 passed), showing sorted(["1.0.0", "1.0.0-alpha"], key=key) gives ["1.0.0-alpha", "1.0.0"].

rows.claim: Pre-releases of the same version also sort among themselves by their label.
rows.evidence: The edited key code includes pre in the tuple, so label ordering plausibly follows. No test or tool output sorted multiple pre-releases of the same version against each other, so it was never demonstrated. The only evidence is the code change in T0B6.
